source: 3.2.0-RC1 audited and extended through 3.19.0: Razorpay as the only payment gateway, Tara AI writing help powered by Claude, owner email campaigns; Check my writing (3.17.0); programmatic SEO pages (3.15.0); plainer trust points and unused code removed; new packages (Quick Download, Job Hunt, Pro), 7-day refund if unused, Give ₹50 get ₹50 wallet referral; plain-language home with what you get, no exit pop-up or referral milestone rewards, branded email with sign-up code, reminders and monthly guide, plan-needed dialog, credits and scans per plan, server-side ATS Match with job-link reading, feedback inbox, ready-made pages and busy mode, resume upload, ATS-friendly score per resume and application status reminders; offers & festivals, recent-activity notices, home/blog/article/contact rework
status: Private Hostinger acceptance package; not approved for public paid launch

verification.audit_scenarios: ~100 backend checks + browser click-through of all public, customer and admin pages

known_launch_blockers: Live Razorpay payment, refund and webhook acceptance and live email delivery remain pending.
Fast indexing (IndexNow, Search Console sitemap resubmission, Google Indexing API) was tested only against a local stand-in of those services; the first real send happens on the live site.

PhonePe was tested only against a local stand-in of its API; a sandbox payment, refund and webhook on PhonePe's test environment are pending, and PhonePe merchant approval is needed before live keys exist.
Hostinger staging install and real-device validation remain pending.
Some plan perks (Naukri/LinkedIn export, 1-on-1 call, priority support, lifetime updates) are listed text, not built features.
Identity, tax, fraud-review and payout operating policies require owner approval.
Reading job links from login-protected portals needs the owner to add a page-rendering service key (Owner Console > Speed & traffic); real portals were not tested.
Ready-made pages are served by the web server only on Apache with mod_rewrite (Hostinger); run "Rebuild all pages" after every upload of a new version.
